Return approved drugs indicated for cardiovascular disease. Select ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, indication EFO ID, indication label, and maximum phase for indication. Source molecule_dictionary joined with compound_structures and drug_indication. Filter for max_phase_for_ind equal to 4 and indication label equal to 'cardiovascular disease'. Sort by ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, indication EFO ID, indication label, and maximum phase for indication in ascending order.
